stem:
The table shows the heights of 10 seedlings.

Heights of Seedlings

| Seedling | A | B | C | D | E | F | G | H | I | J |
|----------|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Height (in.) | 1 1/4 | 2 | 1 1/4 | 1 1/2 | 3/4 | 2 1/4 | 1 1/2 | 1 1/2 | 1 | 2 |
instruction: Which dot plot represents these data?

options.label: F
options.text: Dot plot with highest frequency at 1, other dots at 3/4, 1 1/4, 1 1/2, 2, 2 1/4

options.label: H
options.text: Dot plot with clustered dots near 1 and 2, including some spread between 1 and 2

options.label: G
options.text: Dot plot with dots spread from 3/4 to 2 1/4, including multiple dots near 1 1/4 and 1 1/2

options.label: J
options.text: Dot plot similar to G with spread from 3/4 to 2 1/4 and multiple dots near 1 1/4 and 1 1/2

visual_elements: Table showing seedlings A to J with respective heights: 1 1/4, 2, 1 1/4, 1 1/2, 3/4, 2 1/4, 1 1/2, 1 1/2, 1, 2
